Traffic Advisory – Farrell Street – Wastewater System Repair

From 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM on Wednesday, August 20, Halifax Water crews will perform a wastewater system repair near 1 Farrell Street, Dartmouth. 

Stop-and-go traffic on Farrell Street near the intersection of Farrell Street and Windmill Road. Windmill Road will have an altered centre line.

No impact to services. Sidewalks will remain open.

https://t.co/2p8ECfj7p9
